title: Trimmy: a tiny macOS menu bar app with one job: Paste once, run once.  #github
description:
You know those multi-line shell commands you copy from docs, blogs, or ChatGPT… and then they don’t paste cleanly into your terminal? Yeah — Trimmy fixes that. Trimmy is a tiny macOS menu bar app with one job: ‘Paste once, run once.’ It automatically flattens messy multi-line shell snippets into a clean, single-line command that actually runs. 

#github #opensource
